description: Small valid subset of the ASV table and taxonomy table used as a positive control.
expected_behavior: Group C scripts should run normally.
pass_criteria: Pipeline/module finishes and generates expected outputs without errors.

description: One or more samples have zero total reads.
expected_behavior: The sample should be excluded or clearly flagged as unusable before diversity/rarefaction.
pass_criteria: No silent downstream result is produced for the zero-depth sample.

description: Samples are artificially downsampled to 100 reads.
expected_behavior: The pipeline may complete, but samples should be flagged as low-depth or removed during rarefaction.
pass_criteria: Low-depth warning/exclusion is visible in logs or output tables.

description: The ASV table contains a non-numeric count value.
expected_behavior: The module should stop early with a clear parsing/type error.
pass_criteria: Clear error; no fake downstream diversity/validation outputs.

description: All reads are assigned to a single ASV/taxon.
expected_behavior: The pipeline should complete, but alpha diversity should be extremely low.
pass_criteria: No crash; diversity results are biologically plausible and low.

description: Sample identifiers in metadata do not match the ASV table.
expected_behavior: The pipeline should fail before analysis or report a clear mismatch warning.
pass_criteria: Mismatch detected; no silent sample dropping without warning.

description: Negative controls are spiked with high abundance of selected likely contaminant taxa.
expected_behavior: The contamination filtering step should flag ASVs enriched in controls.
pass_criteria: At least one spiked ASV is flagged or reported as suspicious.
